verdict: The round-1 fixes hold, and the screen now plays as one reward panel with the hit and the part landing together. Four problems remain, three of them in the hero column: A2's rays and rings are cut off flat at the top of the column, C2's second landing covers the kit pips, C2 restarts the replay loop at the second landing, and while the drone carries a part, the part sits on the car body instead of above it.

meets.check: Pinned at 0.6 s (A1 and C2): the panel is visible at [276,66,728,588] with a cyan frame; the HUD columns (x<232, x>1048) are unchanged and do not shake.
meets.note: The panel spans 276–1004 x 66–654. In the shake shots (1.15 s) the panel moves about 3 px, but BODY, DASH, MONUMENT, CHASSIS and POINTS stay pixel-identical.

meets.check: Pinned at 0.6 s: the replay box [600,360,380,228] shows both the dummy and RED-01, the car sprite at least 40 px long, and no rung text or clock.
meets.note: RED-01 is 45–47 px in all four. The dummy is in frame in all four. The box has no clock, REC or rung text.

meets.check: Pinned at 0.6 s: the hero car is nose up inside [375,200,150,320], dimmed, with the new slot empty, kit-colour brackets on it and the drone above with the piece on a tether.
meets.note: All parts present. B1's split tether and C2's two-piece load work. The carried piece overlaps the car body in A1 and C2 (see U4).

meets.check: Pinned at 1.15 s: the replay shows the impact frame with a yellow box on the dummy; the piece is in its slot on the hero car; rings in red and the kit colour are visible inside x<590.
meets.note: The yellow impact box is on the dummy in all four. The rings stay left of x 590. In the impact frame RED-01 is drawn faded (see U7).

meets.check: Pinned at 1.45 s: the label reads 'RED-01 LEARNED' in cyan; the piece name is red at 48 px or less in [600,124,380,48]; the sentence is fully visible in [600,222,380,102].
meets.note: BUMPER STRIP fits in 600–956. Every word of the sentence is drawn, at about 75% of its fade (it fades 1.3–1.5 s, as specced).

meets.check: In every shot, the visible sentence has at most 12 words, no digits, and matches the sentences table for that rung.
meets.note: The sentences have 10, 9, 9 + 7 and 9 words. Each one matches the table word for word.

meets.check: Pinned at 1.7 s: the cyan prompt is right-aligned to x 980 at y 606–630; no yellow text exists outside the replay label and the impact box.
meets.note: 'SPACE · CONTINUE' ends at x 980, y 606–628, on the keyboard path. The only other yellow is the HUD puzzle pill, which is outside the panel.

meets.check: Pinned at 3.0 s vs 1.7 s: the replay frames differ (the loop is running) and the replay stays inside its box; no ray pixels at x≥590.
meets.note: The loop runs, and the car is in view at the start of each loop. The rays stop at about x 588. In A2 they stop against a hard edge at the top instead (see U1).

meets.check: No shot from 0 to 4 s contains 'RUNG', '→', 'CLOSED', 'NEXT', 'TRAINING LOG', 'LESSON:' or 'ENTER'.
meets.note: None of these strings appears in any of the 43 shots.

meets.check: Kit pips at [330,556,240,16]: at 1.0 s the earned count equals the old rung; at 1.3 s it equals the new rung, the newest in the kit colour.
meets.note: Checked against the 0.95 s shots (there is no 1.0 s shot). Counts go 0→1, 1→2, 2→3 and 4→5, and the newest pip is white, steel blue, violet and orange in turn.

meets.check: Two-rung C2, pinned at 1.3, 1.9 and 2.3 s: one panel throughout; at 1.9 s both the roof puck and the link fin are on the car; at 2.3 s two names, two sentences, one replay box and one prompt; no panel scale-in after 0.3 s.
meets.note: One panel throughout, and the second landing has no shake or panel flash. The replay loop restarts at 1.6 s, which goes against the spec (see U3).

meets.check: Reduced motion, pinned at 0.5 and 1.2 s: no drone, no offset, no rotated rays; at 1.2 s the piece is on the car and the name, sentence and a non-blinking prompt are visible.
meets.note: The rays and prompt are identical at 1.2 s and 1.45 s, so nothing turns or blinks. The rays are brighter than the specced 0.2 alpha (see U6).

findings.what: The bumper strip sits at y≈212, only 122 px below the top of the hero column (y 90). The 145 px ray fade only works sideways. In A2 the orange ray fan ends in a flat edge along y 90 across x 305–590, and at 1.30 s the red and orange rings are cut off by the same edge. It reads as a clipping bug right beside the name.
findings.fix: Set the fade radius to the slot's distance from the nearest column edge minus 8 px (the bumper gives about 114 px), so rays reach zero alpha before any edge. Cap ring radius the same way: when the cap is below 180 px, end the ring early instead of drawing past the clip.

findings.what: The link fin lands at y≈480. Its green rays reach y≈605, and the 1.9 s ring (r≈135) runs through the kit pip row [330,556,240,16]. This happens exactly while the fourth pip fills, so the progress readout is hidden behind its own celebration.
findings.fix: Draw the pips above the ray layer on a #0b0f1a plate [322,548,256,32]. Clip rays and rings to y<544, using the same edge-distance fade as U1.

findings.what: In the two-rung C2 build, the replay leaves the impact frame and restarts its loop at 1.6 s, the same moment the link fin lands. The loop opens with RED-01 far from the dummy at [855,440,50,45]. Two motions start at once, and the second landing loses its link to the hit. The spec ties the loop start to the prompt, which shows at 2.1 s for two rungs.
findings.fix: Start the loop at the prompt time (1.6 s for one rung, 2.1 s for two). On two-rung clears, hold the impact frame and yellow box from 1.1 to 2.1 s.

findings.what: With the car nose up, a piece held above a mid-car slot gets drawn on top of the body. In C2 at 0.6 s the roof puck sits on the bonnet at [420,222,60,55], so it reads as already fitted, a step ahead of the lens bar. In A1 the lens bar straddles the nose edge at [420,186,60,20], where it looks like a bumper strip. The arrival stops reading as coming from above.
findings.fix: Keep every carried piece at y≤180 (above the nose) until release at 0.85 s, then let it fall the full length to its slot with trails. While a piece is airborne, draw it at 1.15x with a 6 px offset shadow at 0.35 alpha on the car, so it reads as above the car whenever it crosses the body.

findings.what: Rung 1's kit colour is #f4f8fa, the same white as the landing flash. In A1 the rays are grey-white at 0.30, the pip is white and the lens bar is white, so the first car upgrade a player ever sees is the most colourless one in the game (compare B1, C2, A2).
findings.fix: When the kit colour is #f4f8fa, draw the rays at 0.45 alpha over the red #ff3d3d radial glow at 0.30 (from 0.22), and give the new pip a 1 px #ff3d3d outline. No new colour enters the palette.

findings.what: In reduced motion, the static rays look like about 0.35–0.4 alpha, not the specced 0.2. They are the brightest thing in the hero column and pull the eye from the name.
findings.fix: Draw reduced-motion rays at 0.2 alpha with the same edge-distance fade as U1.

findings.what: In the frozen impact frame, RED-01 is faded to about 50% with a white glyph on it, at [740,465,35,30] (B1) and [740,458,35,28] (A2). The car is weakest at the one beat that should show who hit whom.
findings.fix: For the hold, use the recorded frame one tick before the game's struck-state overlay, so RED-01 is solid red next to the yellow box.
